title: The six PESTLE factors
caption: Six groups of outside forces to scan. A good analysis then says which create an opportunity or a threat and judges which matter most.
alt: Six boxes: political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental, each with examples.
description: Political: government policy, taxation, trade agreements.
Economic: growth, interest rates, inflation, exchange rates.
Legal: employment, consumer, competition, data protection law.
Environmental: climate change, net zero, resource scarcity.
